question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e.** 'Necesity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• This question requires identifying the word that is spelled incorrectly. 
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in this question is** 'Necesity'.**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'Necessity'** (आवश्यकता) .
 
 
• **For example: **Eating food is a necessity for survival.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is - 'Option 1' i.e. **'Necesity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **'Weather'** (Option 2) is spelled accurately(मौसम)
 
• **'Knowledge' **(Option 3) is spelled accurately(ज्ञान)
 
• **'Modest'** (Option 4) is spelled accurately(संकोची)
